verdict.rationale: Fireworks publishes a downloadable OpenAPI 3.1.0 document, the "Gateway REST API" at docs.fireworks.ai/gateway.openapi.yaml. llms.txt lists it under "## OpenAPI Specs" alongside anthropic-messages and gateway-extra specs, so an AI-native user or agent can find it machine-readably. The probe's 404s on conventional paths (openapi.json, swagger.json, .well-known) only show the spec lives at a non-standard path; they do not contradict its existence. Missing for 10: a spec at a conventional or well-known discovery path, explicit evidence that the main spec covers the inference endpoints (e.g. chat completions) rather than mainly management and training, and independent hands-on confirmation of the downloaded spec's contents.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)

citations.quote: Published OpenAPI document ("openapi: 3.1.0", info.title "Gateway REST API", version 5.10.0) covering /v1/accounts, deployment, model and training endpoints
docs.fireworks.ai/llms.txt lists it under "## OpenAPI Specs" together with anthropic-messages.openapi.json and gateway-extra.openapi.yaml
